scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 1 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 144). Qirqib olinadigan karta (qaychi belgisi, to'q sariq punktir ramka). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 1'.

SURATLAR KOLLAJI: flamenko raqqosalari (pushti, oq-qora nuqtali, qizil ko'ylaklar), buqa jangi maydoni (qora buqa va qizil matoli matador), Ispaniya binolari (qal'a va bayroqlar; Sevilyadagi Ispaniya maydoni ko'prigi; zamonaviy shahar va buqa jangi arenasi).

MATN (to'ldiriladigan maqola):
'Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the south-west of Europe. It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.'
'Spaniards are famous for their beauty. They have Mediterranean features, which means that they ......' (3 qator bo'sh)
'In Spain, most people live ......' (4 qator bo'sh)
'The Spanish love to eat ......' (4 qator bo'sh)
'In their free time, Spaniards love ......' (3 qator bo'sh)
'Spain is a fantastic country to visit. Its warm climate and passionate people make it a great place for a holiday.'

⚠ Bu 11-betdagi 33-mashq (Writing) uchun shablon.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. What do they show about Spain?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang. Ular Ispaniya haqida nimani ko'rsatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATLAR:
  • flamenko raqqosalari - rangli
    uzun ko'ylaklar
  • buqa jangi (bullfight) - qora
    buqa, qizil matoli matador
  • qal'a va bayroqlar
  • Sevilya - Ispaniya maydoni
    (Plaza de España) ko'prigi
  • zamonaviy shahar va buqa jangi
    arenasi


⚠ 'FLAMENCO':

  = flamenko (ispan raqsi).


⚠ 'A BULLFIGHT':

  = buqa jangi.
  ⚠ 'a bull' = buqa.


⚠ 'A MATADOR':

  = matador (buqa jangchisi).

items.en: What are the women in the pictures doing?
items.answerEn: They are dancing flamenco in colourful traditional dresses.
items.answerUz: Ular rangli an'anaviy ko'ylaklarda flamenko raqsiga tushmoqda.

items.en: What is happening with the bull?
items.answerEn: It's a bullfight - a matador is holding a red cape in front of the bull.
items.answerUz: Bu buqa jangi - matador buqa oldida qizil mato ushlab turibdi.

items.en: What is Spain famous for, according to the text?
items.uz: Matnga ko'ra, Ispaniya nima bilan mashhur?
items.answerEn: It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.
items.answerUz: U plyajlari, buqa janglari va festivallari bilan mashhur.

structure.modelEn: They have Mediterranean features, which means that they have got black hair, brown eyes and dark skin, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.
structure.modelUz: Ularda O'rta yer dengizi chehrasi bor, ya'ni ular qora sochli, jigarrang ko'zli va qoramtir terili, unchalik baland bo'yli emas. Ular jonli, samimiy va juda kirishimli odamlar.

structure.modelEn: In Spain, most people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.
structure.modelUz: Ispaniyada ko'p odamlar shaharlarda kichik kvartiralarda yashaydi. Ular idoralar, do'konlar va zavodlarda ishlaydi.

structure.modelEn: The Spanish love to eat seafood and omelettes. They usually have a light breakfast and a big lunch late in the afternoon.
structure.modelUz: Ispanlar dengiz mahsulotlari va omlet yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ular odatda yengil nonushta va tushdan keyin kech katta tushlik qiladi.

structure.modelEn: In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes and clubs, and going out for dinner with friends and family.
structure.modelUz: Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafe va klublarga borishni, do'stlari va oilasi bilan tashqarida kechki ovqat qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

modelAnswers:
Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the south-west of Europe. It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.

Spaniards are famous for their beauty. They have Mediterranean features, which means that they have got black hair, brown eyes and dark skin, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.

In Spain, most people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.

The Spanish love to eat seafood and omelettes. They usually have a light breakfast and a big lunch late in the afternoon.

In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes and clubs, and going out for dinner with friends and family.

Spain is a fantastic country to visit. Its warm climate and passionate people make it a great place for a holiday.
